svg.text: validate: risk_class: high escalates every finding

g.text: $ jaato-scaffold validate /srv/acme-support-triage
[error] [workspace] triage: disclosure_absent: binds a persona and declares nothing about whether
natural persons interact with it — set `regulatory.interacts_with_persons` (true: the framework's
disclosure piece and first-interaction announcement apply, Art. 50(1); false: it is a component another
system drives). Absent, nothing decides which. (error because regulatory.risk_class is high) @
regulatory.interact
[error] [workspace] triage: high_risk_without_intended_purpose: risk_class: high with no
`intended_purpose` — the sentence every Annex IV section and every deployer's instructions for use start
from (Art. 11, 13(3)(b)). @ regulatory.intended_purpose
[error] [workspace] triage: high_risk_without_oversight_policy: risk_class: high with no
`plugin_configs.permission.policy` — the permission gate is the framework's human-oversight measure
(Art. 14(4)(d): the person can decide not to use, or override, an output). Declare a policy
(defaultPolicy, whitelist, blacklist, an approval channel); `explain plugin permission` prints the
shape. @ plugin_configs.permission.
[error] [workspace] triage: high_risk_without_record_keeping: risk_class: high with no application trace
configured — `trace.session_log` (or env JAATO_TRACE_LOG) is where every permission DECISION, budget
rung and tool verdict is written, and Art. 12 requires those events recorded automatically over the
system's lifetime. Set `trace: {session_log: .jaato/logs/session_trace.jsonl}`. @ trace.session_log
[error] [workspace] triage: high_risk_without_retention: risk_class: high with no `record_keeping:`
block — the record is written and nothing keeps it: `session.delete` and `workspace.delete` remove the
workspace's logs along with the conversation. Art. 19(1) asks the provider to keep the automatically
generated logs for at least six months (26(6) asks the same of the deployer). Declare `record_keeping:
{retent
[error] [workspace] triage: high_risk_disclosure_suppressed: risk_class: high with
`suppress_base_instructions` naming the `disclosure` piece — the model is no longer told to disclose
that it is an AI system (Art. 50(1), in force since 2 Aug 2026). Remove `disclosure` from the
suppression. @ suppress_base_instructions.disclosure
[info] [workspace] triage: echo_is_a_test_double: provider 'echo' is the framework's deterministic test
double — no credentials, no network, fixed responses. It is absent from `explain providers` (nobody
should pick it for production) but it IS installed, and it is what the live conformance suite runs on. @
provider
[warn] [workspace] triage: echo_reports_no_usage: echo is configured without `usage`, so it reports ZERO
tokens every turn and a turn is entered in the usage ledger only when the provider reported tokens.
Until #881 that ledger also gated the post-turn hook — the one site emitting BOTH TurnCompletedEvent and
SessionTerminatedEvent — so such a session did its work, delivered AgentCompletedEvent and emitted NO
ter
[error] [workspace] triage: budget_control_absent: declares no budget_control, so this session is
unbounded on every dimension (usd, tokens, seconds, tool_calls, turns) — nothing stops a tool-call loop,
and the first sign is the provider bill. Declare a ceiling AND a rung that enforces it, e.g.
budget_control: {limits: {tool_calls: 200, usd: 5.0}, degrade: [{at: 100, action: abort}]}. This profile
binds a default
[info] [workspace] triage: discovery_gated_tools: 3 tool(s) are discovery-gated — DEFERRED, not in the
model's initial schema (the model must call list_tools/get_tool_schemas to reach them):
cli.cli_based_tool, memory.update_memory, memory.delete_memory. Add `<plugin>(preload)` to force a
plugin's tools eager. @ plugins
